note: ep07 Short 'The Nguyens: 15 or 30?' (2026-10-23), 9:16, published with the long-form. Uncle Tu's January 1993 loan replayed both ways on a shared clock (`year` = years since signing). Numbers checked by tools/validate-ep07-story.mjs (short section) and asserted by render/short-nguyens.html.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Fifteen-year mortgage, or thirty years and invest the difference? Uncle Tu took the fifteen in nineteen ninety-three. Let's replay it both ways. *Who ends up richer?*

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The thirty. Two thousand. Stocks are booming. *Sixty-four thousand* invested.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The fifteen. Nothing invested. Every dollar goes to the house.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Two thousand three. The dot-com crash. Down to *forty-eight thousand*.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two thousand eight. House paid off. Now I invest the whole payment, *right into the crash*.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The fifteen won here, and in every finished loan signed at seven to nine percent. But when rates were low, the thirty was ahead at the halfway mark. *The rate decides.* Full story on the channel.
